question: Does a 1-D |omega| refine rescue the s085 L1 failure on fast seed 119 — is the q0-error amplification driven by the |omega|-magnitude error (which the refine fixes) or the omega-direction error (which it does not)?
hypothesis: Refining |omega| first (per the revised v3 stage order) rescues fast seeds; alternatively the failure is direction-driven and the refine cannot help.
narrative_md: A 1-D |omega| refine cannot rescue the s085 L1 failure on fast seed 119: the failure is driven by the 1.5 deg omega-DIRECTION error, not the 0.5% |omega|-magnitude error. Error decomposition: median q0_seed_err 12.90 deg (both errors) -> 12.66 deg (magnitude removed, the refine ceiling) but 4.03 deg (direction removed). Oracle-perfect |omega| still fails (0/6 converge to truth; its one Band A-union-B hit is a 169.6 deg twin), and the refine is non-robust to the direction error (pulled to |omega| -15%, 122 deg off). The lever for fast tumblers is a tighter omega-direction grid (<1.5 deg), not a |omega| refine. Perturbs truth-q and seeds omega relative to truth -> oracle_clean false.
